name: file.io
summary: Anonymous file sharing up to 4 GB: upload a file, share the link, and it self-destructs after download.
description: Upload files or folders in the browser and get a shareable link; each file is deleted after its first download or at its expiry date (14 days by default). All transfers use HTTPS/TLS and stored files are encrypted. No account is required, and a REST API lets scripts upload files or text with a custom expiry (days, weeks, months or years).
contains: upload files and folders, share a link (advertised up to 4 GB)
files deleted after first download or expiry (default 14 days)
REST API: uploads files and text, expires param in days, weeks, months or years
encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest
no account required; no backups once deleted
